answer: Audits are entered in island, queued in lantern, and reef publishes the wait time. A farm of 228 fresh keys thus waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 22 identities per epoch. A farm of 2909 identities would post 4987 proofs and burn roughly 70 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
